headline: Your 401-k’s would be BOOMING
dek: The President says that if he had been on the ballot, the stock market and your 401(k)s would be booming. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: Stocks are down sharply because of the November Third Election results. I wasn’t on the Ballot, but if I was, the results, just like all three times before, would have been much different, and the Stock Market, and your 401-k’s, would be BOOMING. I told you so!!! President DJT
original.key: I wasn’t on the Ballot, but if I was, the results, just like all three times before, would have been much different, and the Stock Market, and your 401-k’s, would be BOOMING.
original.context: Posted on 25 November 2026. The market claims, and the account of their cause, are the President’s. Steve is a fictional character.

verification.note: Copied from the trumpstruth.org archive (status 43729) of truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/117678202296534723 on 26 November 2026; posted 25 November 2026 at 17:14 UTC (12:14 PM Eastern).

meanwhile.hook: Trump says your 401(k)s would be BOOMING. *Meanwhile, at Steve’s house…*
steve: My 401(k) would be booming? Let me check.
Oh, right. I don’t have one. Almost half of families don’t.
*My retirement plan is “keep working.” That one never crashes.*

left.label: 401(k)s
left.note: if he had been on the ballot

fact.text: of American families have no retirement account at all: no 401(k), no IRA (2025). Only 54.9% have one.
fact.source: Federal Reserve, Survey of Consumer Finances 2025 (“Changes in U.S. Family Finances from 2022 to 2025”, October 2026)
